test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight students - P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting exactly in the middle of its sides. S is sitting immediate left of U. R is sitting fourth to the right of S. Q is sitting immediate next to R and V, who is sitting third to the left of T. W is sitting second to the right of T.

Who is sitting immediate next to T and W?
solution:
Given: Eight students - P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. 

1) S is sitting immediate left of U. 

2) R is sitting fourth to the right of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ad0d15d13c5df38372022e6ecddd28931dcc23b7ebe1f98ea0fc1a2f66d2191.png] 

3) Q is sitting immediate next to R and **V, who** is sitting third to the left of T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9db4c7cff914e50ebb5828056cf8ffbce6cc102756d733fb84ef2d0b27dea158.png] 

4) W is sitting second to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/861363ce7563cf75599837b1cb2087d99491e3f9f0b2debb264ccb8f48729a0b.png] 

Then final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9539d227546518745fa27df0c36d69fc522c9859a7d32856831b8c6cca74f111.png] 

So, **P **is sitting immediate next to T and W.

Hence, the correct answer is "P".
